name: Software Engineering
boundaries: Software Engineering: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Fully automatic, correct-by-construction synthesis from informal specifications
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by SWE-02 and SWE-03. SWE-02 is certified synthesis from a reviewable specification. SWE-03 is the adequacy of that specification against informal intent and the environment. Brun et al., TOSEM 2026, split the same vision into requirements, code synthesis, and proof synthesis and say integration remains open. Not given a new ID. The claims that this ends manual coding for 90 percent of software, in any stack, with zero human intervention, are not adopted.

original_dispositions.original_title: Scalable formal verification for arbitrary large-scale systems
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by SWE-01. The historical wording also touches composition (SWE-04) and confinement (SWE-07) when it folds in every concurrency error and every security vulnerability. “Arbitrary,” “all bugs,” and “in hours” are not the SWE-01 completion criterion. End-to-end proof of a particular kernel or of Linux would be a milestone of SWE-01.

Added as SWE-11, narrowed to a practical envelope with a machine-checked observable-equivalence proof. Not a claim that every program can be ported to every language. Overlaps SWE-05 and SWE-06 and does not replace them. CompCert remains a demonstrated special case inside the current state.

original_dispositions.original_title: Self-healing, self-optimizing runtime that never crashes or regresses
original_dispositions.reason: Not added. “Never crashes” exceeds what a software proof can say once physical faults and model assumptions are admitted, as on the seL4 assumptions page. A repair with a proof against a reviewed specification is SWE-02 together with SWE-05. Repair judged by tests has overfitting as an acknowledged open problem in the program-repair survey cited above. Preserving unstated behavior also requires SWE-03 or SWE-06. No distinct principle remains.

original_dispositions.original_title: Provably secure-by-construction architecture that makes common vulnerabilities impossible
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by SWE-07 for confinement of untrusted programs, including covert channels, and by SWE-01 for functional security properties inside a stated specification. Memory safety is already demonstrated and was not promoted to a new concept. A single rule that makes every vulnerability impossible is not a separate, coherent target.

original_dispositions.original_title: Complete predictive theory of maintainability and evolution
original_dispositions.reason: Not added. Lehman’s laws already exist, and Herraiz et al., ACM Computing Surveys 2013, report that studies of their validity are commonly controversial. A high-accuracy forecast from metrics would be valuable and is still an estimation problem. It does not specify a new way to build, assure, or compose software. The related revolutionary capability is SWE-05.

original_dispositions.original_title: End-to-end verified distributed-systems construction from consistency, availability, and fault-tolerance properties
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by SWE-08, which was amended to take those properties as inputs and to reject combinations that partitions make jointly impossible. CALM remains the achieved classification theorem, not the compiler. The historical claim that this ends partition tradeoffs, or makes blockchain systems trivial, is not adopted.

original_dispositions.original_title: Universal reproducible and deterministic builds with cryptographic provenance
original_dispositions.reason: Not added. Bit-identical rebuilds are demonstrated for about 95 percent of current Debian suites in the 2026-11-01 dashboard snapshot, and for 69 to 91 percent of 709,816 historical Nix packages in Malka et al. The remaining gap is incremental relative to that demonstration. I did not inspect a universal cryptographic-provenance system for every future toolchain. Bit identity is distinguished inside SWE-10 and is not a behavioral proof.

original_dispositions.original_title: General theory of software complexity with tight lower bounds for any problem
original_dispositions.reason: Not added. Case-by-case complexity results already exist. A procedure that returns a tight bound and an optimal architecture for an arbitrary software task is not a specified discovery, and semantic equivalence is undecidable in general. No software-engineering artifact was isolated that meets the revolutionary-impact bar.

original_dispositions.original_title: Autonomous software-engineering agent that outperforms human teams
original_dispositions.reason: Not added. Coding agents are a labor and machine-learning trend. Trustworthy autonomy, as Brun et al. frame it, is requirements elicitation (SWE-03), certified synthesis (SWE-02), and proof synthesis (SWE-01), and they say each prong and their integration are still research. The October 2026 Anthropic proofs show models producing checker input for a bounded property. I found no inspected basis for a 100-fold or 1,000-fold claim, and I do not use one.
